title: Codex x DSH Team Toolkit release manifest
description: Written by tools/Build-Release.ps1 and consumed by install/Invoke-Toolkit.ps1. Every path is relative: 'path' is relative to the target project root, 'source' is relative to the extracted package root. Only files listed here are ever installed. Entries carry location metadata only: no digest field exists, no digest is read, validated or stored, and the toolkit makes no claim about the integrity of the release transport (that belongs to the distribution channel).

path.description: normalized relative path inside the target project

source.description: normalized relative path inside the package root
